obfuscation_indicators: going forward we expect more variability
risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively quantitative and clearly reports improved revenue, margins, operating income, and cash flow. However, the 51% backlog decline, 0.63 book-to-bill ratio, customer concentration, manufacturing execution risks, and reliance on operating cash and available cash create meaningful forward-looking risk. Net income also benefited materially from PPP loan forgiveness and elevated scrap income, which may reduce earnings comparability.
